"""Independent expectations for the offline evidence pipeline (test authoring)."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

def fp(b):
    if isinstance(b, str): b = b.encode('utf-8')
    n = len(b); h = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(b): h = (h*257 + x + 1) % (2**64)
    return {'n': n, 'h': '%016x' % h}

def rand_token(seed, coordinate, occurrence):
    return hashlib.sha256(f'{seed}/{coordinate}/{occurrence}'.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:20]

def action(at, stream, kind, data, end):
    out = at.to_bytes(8,'big') + stream.to_bytes(4,'big') + kind.encode()
    if kind in ('H','h'):
        out += len(data).to_bytes(8,'big')
        for n,v in data:
            out += len(n).to_bytes(8,'big') + n + len(v).to_bytes(8,'big') + v
    else:
        out += len(data).to_bytes(8,'big') + data
    out += b'\x01' if end else b'\x00'
    return out

def field_block(pairs):
    out = len(pairs).to_bytes(8,'big')
    for n,v in pairs:
        out += len(n).to_bytes(8,'big') + n + len(v).to_bytes(8,'big') + v
    return out

def run(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'], input=raw.encode('utf-8'),
                       cwd='/workspace/project', capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr[-3000:])
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())

def run_raw(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','main.py'], input=raw,
                       cwd='/workspace/project', capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    return p

import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import *

failures = []
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append((name, got, want))
        print('FAIL', name); print('  got ', json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:600]); print('  want', json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:600])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)

def base(**kw):
    doc = {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc

# --- timeout: no response ever
frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
c = r['cases'][0]
sent = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')], False)
check('timeout state', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames']), ('timeout',10,1,1))
check('timeout sent', c['sent'], fp(sent))
check('timeout received', c['received'], fp(b''))
check('timeout response', (c['response_frames'],c['response_body']), (0, fp(b'')))
check('timeout payload', c['payload_bytes'], sum(len(x) for p in [(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')] for x in p))
check('timeout flags', c['flags'], ['missing_origin'])
check('timeout origin', c['origin_count'], 0)

# --- close terminates awaiting case
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('closed state', (c['state'],c['at']), ('closed',3))

# --- close terminates paused sender, earlier emissions kept
frames2=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":7},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"body","End_Stream":True}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames2,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":3,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
exp_sent = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')], False)
check('paused close', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames']), ('closed',3,1,1))
check('paused close sent', c['sent'], fp(exp_sent))
check('paused close payload', c['payload_bytes'], 3+1+1+1+4+1+1)

# --- close after already ok does not replace result
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":9,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('ok then close', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames']), ('ok',1,1))
check('ok then close received', c['received'], fp(action(1,0,'h',[(b':status',b'204'[:0]+b'200')], True)))

# --- send_error: frame after End_Stream
frames3=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"late"}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames3,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
exp = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')], True)
check('send_error', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames']), ('send_error',0,1,1))
check('send_error sent', c['sent'], fp(exp))
check('send_error flags', c['flags'], ['missing_origin'])

# --- sleep after request end still permitted; sleep consumes time
frames4=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":4}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames4,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":4,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('sleep after end', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames']), ('ok',4,1))

# --- response retained while still sending (ok at send finish)
frames5=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
         {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":5},
         {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":True}]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":frames5,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"resp","end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
exp_sent = action(0,0,'H',[(':method',b'GET'),(':authority',b'h'),(':path',b'/')],False) + action(5,0,'D',b'x',True)
check('retain while sending', (c['state'],c['at']), ('ok',5))
check('retain while sending sent', c['sent'], fp(exp_sent))
check('retain while sending received', c['received'], fp(action(2,0,'d',b'resp',True)))
check('retain body', c['response_body'], fp(b'resp'))

# --- datagram: End_Stream ignored, final byte 0, request_frames 0
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"dg","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('datagram state', (c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['request_frames']), ('ok',1,1,0))
check('datagram sent', c['sent'], fp(action(0,0,'G',b'dg',False)))
check('datagram flags', c['flags'], ['unsent_origin'])

# --- unknown stream / later response events ignored / response end stops retention
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":2,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"nope","end":True},
                   {"at":3,"kind":"headers","stream":99,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True},
                   {"at":4,"kind":"data","stream":8,"data":"alsonope","end":True}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('ignore later', (c['state'],c['at'],c['response_frames']), ('ok',1,1))
check('ignore later received', c['received'], fp(action(1,0,'h',[(b':status',b'200')], True)))

# --- tied response event beats timeout; second case timeout ordering
doc = base(timeout_ms=5,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}},
                  {"name":"b","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}])
cs = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases']
check('tie wins', (cs[0]['state'],cs[0]['at']), ('ok',5))
check('other times out', (cs[1]['state'],cs[1]['at']), ('timeout',5))
check('stream ids', [c['stream'] for c in cs], [0,4])

# --- zero pause yields to same-time external events
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]},
                                        {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":2}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}],
           events=[{"at":2,"kind":"close"}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
check('zero pause yields', (c['state'],c['at']), ('closed',2))

print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
